editorNote: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, its new top model, though the Gemini app and Antigravity rollout is limited to paying users for now. Google also opened Play Store distribution for private, prompt-built Android apps. Elsewhere, Character.ai filed for bankruptcy, and a Meta frontier model is reported but unconfirmed.
